toxicMaterial.name: Botulinum neurotoxin
toxicMaterial.description: Botulinum neurotoxin is the causal toxic material in botulism. This record describes toxin production and exposure without treating the producing bacterium as venomous.
toxicMaterial.ecologicalRoleSummary: Toxin production may contribute to bacterial persistence or competition in suitable anaerobic contexts, but the ecological role is not fully characterized here.

components.summary: Botulinum neurotoxin is the principal toxic material represented by this dossier.
